reasoning: Longitudinally cut tomato stem showing a large dark external canker near the soil line (left side) with extensive dark brown to near-black pith discoloration and cracked dry internal tissue extending above and below the canker. This matches Alternaria stem canker descriptions: dark-brown to almost black cankers with vascular/pith tissue developing brown streaks and cracking.
